Overview

Rio Branco is a city in AC with a population of 419,452. The westernmost state capital of Brazil, surrounded by Amazon rainforest and known for its rubber history and cultural diversity. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Sunshine is limited, with about 75 sunny days a year. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
